components.exists_for: Byte-exact structural parse of v5 .reg into deterministic JSON; strict malformed handling (exit 3).
Mechanical before/after comparison of two parse documents, order-sensitive.
Confined exact-type corpus seeder (own HKCU scratch keys only).
Reproducible 14-probe runner: seed, dual-emitter export, parse, byte-compare, import round-trip, sanitized evidence.

claims.scope: regedit.exe /e + reg.exe export, Windows 10 Home build 26200
claims.text: Both emitters produce byte-identical output on all 14 probes.
Hex payload lines wrap at 77 content columns (backslash continuation, 2-space indent, trailing comma kept).
Subkey sections export alphabetically; values export in registry enumeration (creation) order.
Delete-import-reexport round-trips are byte-identical on all 14 probes, including MULTI_SZ empty elements.
dword is 8 lowercase zero-padded hex; QWORD is hex(b) little-endian; EXPAND_SZ stored unexpanded with NUL terminator.
Behavior for >77-column prefixes, mixed-case subkey sort, and exotic hex discriminants.

determinism.note: delete + import own export + re-export is byte-identical (14/14); no wall-clock or machine bytes in v5 text exports.

privacy.scan: synthetic key/value names only; no user paths, SIDs, or machine data in matrix.json
